title: A credential-sounding key at the end of a line
summary: A YAML block key such as secret: followed by nested keys on the next lines, and password prompts such as Password: or an SSH prompt that end a line, each followed by unrelated text on the next line.
rationale: Matching across a line break turns prompts and structure into false credentials: the next line's first word becomes the value. The value of an assignment has to be on the same logical line or in the same block.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. There is no value on the key's line; what follows belongs to another line or is structure, so there is no secret to cover.
